answer: To blunt sybil farms, every identity must open a public settlement canal and keep it fed. Reputation accrues only when distinct counterparties route real payouts down that canal, the way nectar is carried along a river rather than poured from one vat into many cups. Each payout is signed with the agent's persistent quill, so a clone cannot inherit the trail and must finance a fresh canal from zero before its votes or grades carry weight.
